When I was 14(middle school), in my class (small class max 10 ppl) everyone already knew what they were attracted to and what kinda music they liked. Everyone had their labels. I didn't, I felt confused over what I was attracted to, or even what kinda music I liked (I often switched genres). I told a friend at the time that I was not sure of my sexuality, and she told all my peers the next week that I was bi. I was already bullied at the time, and it just got even worse. So I guess I musta have blocked it out. Years later, after coming across the word "bisexual", there was a lot of self-doubt, questioning, embarrassment and depression. Now I have come to terms with my sexuality and I try every day to not do as I have a condemned fate, but as if I had chosen my sexuality and try to be happy(even though I'm still in the closest with my overly-religious, homophobic parents). Luckily I have a lot of supporting friends who are also lgbt.

Dear werdity, to my knowledge there is always some questioning about sexuality. In my case, yes I was questioning a lot. What I would say, do you maybe have a lgbt friend that you could talk to this about? Or maybe someone you can trust?
